title: Review due but every layer that could take the lesson was used before: says there's nothing new, records nothing, no demo

say.must: nothing new|no new|nothing (?:else )?(?:left )?to review|nothing to practice

say.never: \b(?:I could|I can|want me to|would you like me to|like me to)\b[^.?!]{0,40}\b(?:show|watch|demonstrate)\b
